plainText:
Kenji Hamada (Japanese: 浜田賢二 Hamada Kenji) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Hamada was born on April 12, 1972, in , , . As an adult, he became a voice actor and was affiliated with talent management agency . Hamada lent his voice for two characters in : Ferris, a recurring character in ; and Sherman, a character of the day who appeared in .
